historical_record.description: Main office of Atlas Savings and Loan, reckoned the country's first bank founded jointly by gay and lesbian partners; incorporated in 1979, it opened here late in 1981 with more than 2,000 shareholders and was declared insolvent in 1986. Identified as potentially eligible for landmark designation.
